hard_fails: Narration names Keller Cliffton, Round Rock, north of Houston and an Uber executive, words that are in claim text but not in any claim quote
rounds.defects: Spring drawn as the coast, marsh, open water and wind turbines behind every Harris shot; weak hook frame with a small dog and no pod, and the dog floating over the customer at s8-b

The customer stands front-on with hands clasped at one size through s2, s7, s8, s9 and s14 and the b-shots repeat their a-shots, so 46s to 82s plays as a slideshow; the hook frame shows a neutral dog with the pod cropped late, and the s3 restaurant is a blank box where the pickup is never shown

Repeated frames and slideshow posing: the same pine avenue behind s4-b, s6 and s9 and the customer standing neutral; s7's hover and tether line shows no pod or tether, and the cold open dog stands stiff instead of crouching at the latch with the pod big

The hook frame still opens on a side-on standing dog with the pod cropped under the Texas chip and two text layers; held and repeated frames, s2 porch and s9 the same medium shot, s10 and s12 b-shots near copies, and the s8 32 foot drone sits below the pine tops with no numbered ticks

Second shots repeat their first shot's frame and people stand still while the line describes action, s2 porch, s10 override desk, s11 students who never catch the pod; type collisions, the 330 ft tag behind the label chip and the very quiet card text smearing, with s6 rain not reading in its first frame

The s14 payoff misreads, the sack sits on the customer's head while her arms are raised so the hand taking the sack is never shown; the s12 Dallas million is only printed, the dozen pods into backyards never read, with held standing frames in s2, s9 and s13
